message.content:
In the Rankora project at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora, check the database schema and edge functions for anything related to these features:

1. Read supabase/migrations/ — list all migration files and read the most recent 5-10 to understand the current DB schema. Look for tables/columns related to: interviews, scheduling, knockout questions, rejection emails, whatsapp, API keys, webhooks
2. Read src/integrations/supabase/types.ts — search for types related to: interviews, bookings, api_keys, knockout, rejection, whatsapp
3. Check supabase/functions/ — list all edge functions and identify which ones relate to: email sending, interview scheduling, candidate communication, API endpoints
4. Check if there's any webhook infrastructure beyond Dodo payments
5. Look for any availability/booking system (BookInterview, BookDemo pages)

Report what DB tables and edge functions exist that could support these Tier 2 features.
